catalog.pediakidOmega.fullDescription: These gummies provide omega-3 fatty acids in a chewable supplement for children. Check the pack for the recommended age, ingredients and allergen information.
catalog.pediakidIron.fullDescription: This liquid supplement for children combines iron with B vitamins to supplement dietary intake. Check the box for the age guidance and amount per serving.
catalog.pediakidD3.fullDescription: The bottle dispenses liquid vitamin D3 in drops to supplement dietary intake. Check the packaging for the amount per drop and age guidance.
catalog.pediakidImmuno.shortDescription: Pediakid Immuno-Fort nutritional syrup for children.
catalog.pediakidImmuno.fullDescription: The liquid supplement is formulated with plant extracts and micronutrients, including vitamin C and copper. Check the pack for the full ingredient list and age guidance.
catalog.surfaceGel.fullDescription: This cleaning gel is intended for hard surfaces such as bathroom fixtures. The angled bottle helps direct the gel onto the surface. Follow the label for suitable surfaces and use.
catalog.aniosGel.shortDescription: Aniosgel 85 NPC hand sanitizer in a pump bottle.
catalog.aniosGel.fullDescription: This hydroalcoholic gel is designed to be rubbed over the hands for hand disinfection. The pump dispenses the gel without pouring it from the bottle.
catalog.anklebrace.fullDescription: This type of support wraps around the ankle. Check the sizing chart and adjustment instructions when choosing a model.
catalog.antiseptic.fullDescription: Application areas and directions depend on the formula. Read the label or leaflet before applying it.
catalog.ashwagandha.fullDescription: Ashwagandha supplements may use different plant parts or extracts. Check the ingredients and ask a pharmacist if you take medication.
catalog.b12.fullDescription: Vitamin B12 is also called cobalamin. Compare formulas by the form of vitamin B12 and the amount per serving.
catalog.baby.fullDescription: The milk texture spreads over the skin to lift everyday dirt during a diaper change or wash. Check the bottle for the intended application areas and whether to rinse.
catalog.baby.shortDescription: Cleansing milk for a baby’s skin.
catalog.backbelt.fullDescription: The belt covers the lumbar area and fastens around the waist. The pictured design has vertical supports along the back and an adjustable outer strap.
catalog.bodywash.fullDescription: This rinse-off gel is designed for cleansing the body in the shower. The pump bottle dispenses the gel directly into the hand.
catalog.bodywash.shortDescription: Neutraderm Dermo-Protect extra-rich shower gel, 500 mL.
catalog.bpmonitor.fullDescription: This type of monitor measures blood pressure with a cuff around the upper arm. Choose a cuff that fits your arm circumference and follow the instructions.
catalog.bpmonitor.shortDescription: Electronic blood pressure monitor with an upper-arm cuff.
catalog.calcium.fullDescription: Vitamin D helps the body absorb calcium. Compare formulas using the amounts of calcium and vitamin D per serving separately.
catalog.calcium.shortDescription: A supplement pairing calcium with vitamin D.
catalog.collagen.fullDescription: Collagen is a protein. If you need to avoid marine-derived ingredients, check the pack for the collagen source and allergen information.
catalog.compressionglove.fullDescription: The glove follows the shape of the hand. Check sizing and wearing instructions when choosing a model.
catalog.coolinggel.fullDescription: This type of gel is applied locally to provide a cooling sensation. Check the pack for the intended application areas.
catalog.creatine.fullDescription: Creatine monohydrate is a common form of creatine in sports supplements. Check the label for any additional ingredients.
catalog.crutches.fullDescription: Crutches provide support while walking. Ask a professional to check that the height, adjustments and weight capacity are appropriate.
catalog.ginseng.fullDescription: Ginseng is a botanical ingredient. When comparing products, look for the plant’s botanical name and the part used.
catalog.handcream.fullDescription: This leave-on cream moisturizes dry hands and conditions the skin around the nails. It can be massaged into the hands and cuticles.
catalog.handcream.shortDescription: Sisley restorative hand and nail cream, 75 mL.
catalog.heatpad.fullDescription: The pad provides warmth where it is placed. Follow the manufacturer’s directions for temperature and duration of use.
catalog.heatpad.shortDescription: Electric heating pad for localized warmth.
catalog.wheyStrawberry.fullDescription: This whey-based powder supplements dietary protein intake. Delicious Strawberry provides 24 g of protein per serving. Contains milk.
catalog.wheyStrawberry.shortDescription: Optimum Nutrition Gold Standard 100% Whey, strawberry-flavoured protein powder.
catalog.creatineGalvanize.fullDescriptio: This creatine monohydrate powder is intended for sports nutrition. The unflavoured powder can be mixed into a drink of your choice in line with the package directions.
catalog.creatineGalvanize.shortDescripti: Galvanize Nutrition unflavoured creatine monohydrate powder, 500 g tub.
catalog.listerineMint.fullDescription: This daily mint mouthwash is an oral rinse to complement brushing. Follow the directions and precautions on the bottle.
catalog.listerineMint.shortDescription: Listerine Teeth and Gum Protection mouthwash, fresh mint, 250 mL.
catalog.insoles.fullDescription: The gel pad sits between the ball of the foot and the shoe, adding a cushioned layer in the area that bears weight as you push off while walking.
catalog.insoles.shortDescription: Gel cushions for the front of the foot inside a shoe.
catalog.iron.fullDescription: Iron is a mineral and vitamin B9 is a folate. Check the pack for each nutrient’s form and amount per serving.
catalog.iron.shortDescription: A supplement combining iron and vitamin B9.
catalog.k2.fullDescription: Vitamin K2 is part of the vitamin K family. If you take a vitamin K antagonist, ask a pharmacist before choosing a supplement.
catalog.kinesiology.fullDescription: Cut the roll to the length you need. Check the packaging directions before applying the tape to the skin.
catalog.kneesleeve.fullDescription: The straps hold the support around the knee and allow the fit to be adjusted. The front opening leaves the kneecap uncovered.
catalog.kneesleeve.shortDescription: Wraparound knee support with straps and an opening over the kneecap.
catalog.magb6.fullDescription: Compare these formulas by the form of magnesium and the amounts of magnesium and vitamin B6 per serving.
catalog.magb6.shortDescription: A supplement pairing magnesium with vitamin B6.
catalog.melatonin.fullDescription: The body also produces melatonin naturally. Ask a pharmacist before choosing a supplement if you take medication or are shopping for a child.
catalog.multi.fullDescription: Multivitamin formulas vary. Compare options using the list of nutrients and the amounts per serving.
catalog.nasal.fullDescription: The nozzle delivers a spray into the nose. Saline and medicated nasal sprays serve different purposes. Check the pack for ingredients and intended use.
catalog.nebulizer.fullDescription: A nebulizer turns a compatible liquid into a mist. Follow the instructions for the model and use only a solution intended for nebulization.
catalog.neckpillow.fullDescription: The curved profile provides a surface under the neck while the head rests on the pillow.
catalog.neckpillow.shortDescription: Contoured pillow for neck support at rest.
catalog.omega3.fullDescription: Omega-3 is a family of fatty acids. Compare supplements by their source and their EPA and DHA amounts where listed.
catalog.omega7.fullDescription: Omega-7 is a family of fatty acids. Compare packaging for the source of the oil and the amount per serving.
catalog.omega7.shortDescription: Omega-7 fatty acid supplement in capsules.
catalog.posture.fullDescription: A posture support is worn around the upper body. Check the sizing and fitting instructions to find an appropriate fit.
catalog.probiotic.fullDescription: Probiotic products differ in the strains they contain. Check the strains, colony-forming units and storage instructions where listed on the packaging.
catalog.quercetin.fullDescription: Quercetin belongs to the flavonoid family. Compare products by the amount per serving and their other ingredients.
catalog.resistance.fullDescription: The elastic bands stretch to provide resistance during movement and can be stored together between sessions.
catalog.resistance.shortDescription: Set of three resistance bands for exercise.
catalog.royaljelly.fullDescription: Royal jelly is a bee product. If you are allergic to bee products, ask a pharmacist before use.
catalog.saline.fullDescription: Saline solutions come in several formats. Check the pack to choose a product intended for the area you want to clean.
catalog.sanitizer.fullDescription: Choose a gel labeled for the area or surface you intend to treat. The packaging directions tell you where and how to use it.
catalog.sleepmask.fullDescription: The mask covers the eyes while you rest, at home or while travelling, to reduce the light reaching them.
catalog.sleepmask.shortDescription: Sleep mask that reduces exposure to ambient light.
catalog.sock.fullDescription: Choose compression socks by the size and compression level shown on the pack. Ask a pharmacist if you have been prescribed a specific class.
catalog.spirulina.fullDescription: Spirulina is an ingredient derived from cyanobacteria. Check the pack for the source, ingredients and serving size.
catalog.sunscreen.fullDescription: Check the pack for its SPF, UVA protection and water-resistance information when choosing sun protection. Follow the directions on the product.
catalog.thermometer.fullDescription: Use forehead mode as directed for your model. The instructions show how to position the device when taking a temperature.
catalog.thumbsplint.fullDescription: This support wraps around the thumb. Its adjustable fit lets you change the tension around the hand and thumb.
catalog.toothpaste.fullDescription: This toothpaste contains baking soda and xylitol along with fluoride. It is intended for daily brushing and helps remove surface stains.
catalog.toothpaste.shortDescription: Superwhite Original whitening fluoride toothpaste, 75 mL.
catalog.bandageRoll.fullDescription: The roll lets you adjust coverage by overlapping each turn. Choose a width that suits the area and follow the package instructions.
catalog.bandageRoll.shortDescription: Flexible bandage roll that wraps around the area to cover.
catalog.curcuminCapsules.fullDescription: Curcumin is one of the compounds naturally found in turmeric rhizomes. When comparing formulas, check the amount of curcuminoids per serving and the other ingredients on the pack.
catalog.etolFort.fullDescription: Pack of 14 film-coated tablets, each containing 400 mg of etodolac. This prescription medicine is used for certain types of joint pain, among other indications. Contains lactose. Follow your prescription and avoid combining it with another NSAID without medical advice.
catalog.etolFort.shortDescription: Nobel Etol Fort, a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory medicine containing etodolac.
catalog.footSleeve.fullDescription: The sleeve slides onto the foot to cover the area without winding a strip around it. Use the sizing guide on the packaging to choose a fit.
catalog.footSleeve.shortDescription: Slip-on tubular sleeve for the foot.
catalog.omega3Capsules.fullDescription: The capsule format makes it possible to compare amounts per capsule. Check the bottle for separate EPA and DHA amounts and read the allergen information if you need to avoid fish.
catalog.omega3Capsules.shortDescription: Omega-3 fatty acid supplement in capsules.
catalog.unavailable.fullDescription: Ask a pharmacist to confirm the exact item and its intended use before choosing this product.
catalog.vitc.fullDescription: Vitamin C is also known as ascorbic acid. When comparing supplements, check the amount per serving and the ingredient list on the pack.
catalog.vitd.fullDescription: Vitamin D helps the body absorb calcium. Compare products using the form of vitamin D and the amount per serving shown on the package.
catalog.vite.fullDescription: Vitamin E refers to a family of compounds. Compare supplements by the form and amount of vitamin E per serving on the pack.
catalog.whey.fullDescription: Whey is the liquid portion of milk separated during cheesemaking. Its proteins provide essential amino acids. Whey is derived from milk. Check the pack for allergen details and protein per serving.
catalog.whey.shortDescription: Whey protein to supplement dietary protein intake, including as part of a sports nutrition routine.
catalog.wristwrap.fullDescription: A wrist support fits close to the joint. Check the size and fastening before choosing one.
catalog.wristwrap.shortDescription: Flexible support worn around the wrist.
catalog.yeast.fullDescription: Brewer’s yeast comes in several forms, including powders and tablets. Check the pack for the form and any additional ingredients.
catalog.zinc.fullDescription: Zinc and magnesium are two minerals. When comparing supplements, check the amounts of zinc and magnesium per serving separately on the pack.
catalog.zinc.shortDescription: A supplement pairing zinc and magnesium.
